hero.lead: Our firm represents families and individuals who have suffered minor and major injuries, or the loss of someone they love, in accidents caused by somebody else. Consultations are free and you only pay if we win.

overview.title: Injury cases we handle for clients across the Houston area.
overview.text: Pick the kind of accident you were in to see how we handle it, or call and talk it through with an attorney.

services.title: Car Accidents
services.summary: Compensation after a crash, big or small.
services.text: Whether the crash damaged only the car or sent you to the hospital, we deal with the insurance company so that nobody takes advantage of your situation.
services.lead: Car accidents are always unexpected, and for many they happen at the worst possible time. If you are seeking compensation, or the insurance company is refusing the payment you deserve, our attorneys in Houston are here to represent you.
services.imageAlt: A car with front-end damage after a collision

covers.title: Distracted drivers
covers.text: A phone, something on the floor, a turn to the back seat. A small distraction is enough to cause a crash, and the consequences can be severe.

covers.title: Rear-end crashes
covers.text: One of the most common collisions, and a frequent source of neck, whiplash, back, spinal and brain injuries that take months or years to heal.

covers.title: Overturned vehicles
covers.text: Usually the result of a major accident, with speed and wet or icy roads among the factors that cause a vehicle to roll.

covers.title: Drivers under the influence
covers.text: Drugs and alcohol slow the reaction a driver needs to brake or stop. These cases are more sensitive because illegal acts are involved.

covers.title: Uber and Lyft vehicles
covers.text: Rideshare companies carry large policies and legal teams that work to get cases dismissed. We handle them for you.

covers.title: Uninsured or underinsured drivers
covers.text: These claims are more complicated and fair compensation is harder to reach, which is exactly when having an attorney matters.

questions.q: What should I do at the scene of a crash?
questions.a: Call the police, exchange information with the other driver, note the plate, make, model and color, take photos of the damage, and do not accept money to settle on the spot.

questions.q: The damage looks minor. Do I still need an attorney?
questions.a: It does not matter whether the crash damaged only part of the car or caused injuries that need immediate medical attention. An attorney keeps others from taking advantage of your situation.

services.title: Semi-Truck Accidents
services.summary: Claims against trucking and insurance companies.
services.text: A truck's weight, size and stopping distance make these among the most dangerous accidents on the road, and the policies behind them among the hardest fought.
services.lead: Insurance companies that serve large trucking firms often try not to pay what their policies cover, because those policies are far larger than a car policy and they have much more to lose. Their legal staff will push you to talk. We make sure that does not cost you your case.

covers.title: Document preparation
covers.text: Knowing which documents start your case is not simple. Every case is different and each one needs a meticulous investigation.

covers.title: Reports for insurance companies
covers.text: Any error or omission in a report can be used to annul your case, so these are written carefully.

covers.title: Taking testimony
covers.text: Witness testimony needs the right questions, or it produces documents that cannot be used in front of a judge or jury.

covers.title: A legal strategy
covers.text: Truck cases turn on details that are unique to them. We take each one into account in the strategy for your case.

covers.title: Legal representation
covers.text: If the trucking company complicates the case and it goes before a judge and jury, you have two attorneys who take it personally.

covers.title: Negotiations and decisions
covers.text: Settlement offers often differ from what negotiation reaches. When there is more than one offer, we help you choose.

questions.q: Who can be held responsible for a truck accident?
questions.a: The driver, the company the truck belongs to, the truck's owner, the companies that rent the truck or trailer, the company that loaded it, and the manufacturers of truck or trailer parts.
Driver error and long hours, trucks that are not properly serviced, equipment and parts that fail, and cargo that was loaded against regulation.

services.title: Motorcycle Accidents
services.text: A rider has no shell around them, so most of the impact is taken by the person on the motorcycle. These accidents lead to grievous injuries and even death.
services.lead: Motorcycles do not show up well in the mirrors of cars, and distracted drivers with poor visibility are the usual reason these accidents happen. We know traffic accidents happen for different reasons and that no two cases are the same.

covers.title: Preparation of legal documents
covers.text: The law changes, and what was the right way to present a case or a document can change with it. We keep current so your filing holds up.

covers.title: Reports
covers.text: Insurance companies are known for having a claim dismissed over a technical flaw in a report. We will not let them take advantage of you.

covers.title: Witness testimony
covers.text: Statements taken at the time give your attorneys the information and the proof of what happened.

covers.title: A strategy for your case
covers.text: Every motorcycle accident is unique, so the strategy is built around your case and what you need from it.

questions.q: What can I do to ride more safely?
questions.a: Wear a helmet, keep your headlights on, wear proper clothing and boots, keep your distance, maintain the brakes, tires and lights, ride defensively and do not ride tired.

questions.q: What if the insurer refuses to pay what I need?
questions.a: That is where representation matters. Elisa Salazar and Paola Velazquez take the case to the people who caused it and to the company behind them.

services.title: Pedestrian Accidents
services.summary: For people hit by a car while walking.
services.text: Pedestrians are hit by cars regularly, and while most of these are accidental, the driver of the vehicle is usually at fault.
services.lead: In 2019, pedestrians accounted for 17% of all motor vehicle crash fatalities, with 21% of those from hit-and-run accidents (IIHS, 2021). If you have been hit by a car, our injury attorneys can help.

covers.title: Distracted driving
covers.text: A phone, a text, food, a glance into the back seat. Those few seconds cause many pedestrian accidents.

covers.title: Speeding
covers.text: A faster car takes longer to slow, so the driver does not have the time they need to stop.

covers.title: Driving under the influence
covers.text: An impaired driver may not see the person at all, or cannot react fast enough to stop.

covers.title: Failing to yield
covers.text: Drivers in a hurry run red lights and stop signs. Pedestrians always have the right of way.

covers.title: Driving too fast for conditions
covers.text: Fog, ice and poor visibility leave a driver unable to slow in time.

covers.title: Backing up
covers.text: Backup cameras have reduced these accidents, but children especially are still hit by vehicles reversing at home or in a parking lot.

questions.q: What is the driver responsible for?
questions.a: Drivers must stay vigilant and always yield to pedestrians. In Texas, a negligent driver who hits a pedestrian inside a crosswalk commits a Class A misdemeanor, which can carry up to two years in jail.

questions.q: What is the pedestrian responsible for?
questions.a: Obeying traffic control devices, not jaywalking, using a sidewalk where there is one, and giving drivers time to stop before stepping into a crosswalk.

services.title: Bicycle Accidents
services.summary: When a rider is hit by a car in Houston.
services.text: Biking is popular here, with so many parks and trails, but bikes are often hit by cars in collisions that can affect your life for years.
services.lead: Our team has many clients who were hit by a car while riding a bicycle. If you have been the victim of a bicycle accident, call for a free consultation.
services.imageAlt: A man riding a city bicycle on the street

covers.title: The right hook
covers.text: A vehicle passes the rider on the left, then cuts back across too early. This accounts for almost 15% of all bike accidents (NHTSA).

covers.title: The right cross
covers.text: A car pulls out from the right in front of a rider and causes the crash.

covers.title: The left cross
covers.text: A car turning left turns into an oncoming bicycle, which can be a head-on collision and cause severe injury.

covers.title: Hit from behind
covers.text: About 45% of bicycle and car collisions happen with the car and the bike heading the same direction (IIHS).

covers.title: Car dooring
covers.text: The driver of a parked car opens a door in front of a rider, which is devastating if the rider is bounced into traffic.

questions.a: The police come to the scene and file a report, witness testimony is taken, and a citation may be issued. See a doctor or go to the hospital so your injuries are assessed and on record.
Yes. Running red lights and stop signs, weaving through traffic, failing to signal and unsafe lane changes all cause accidents, and our attorneys know the law that applies to riders in Texas.

services.title: Personal Injuries
services.summary: Negligence, strict liability and intentional wrongs.
services.text: Personal injury, also known as tort law, lets you file a civil case against the person or company whose actions harmed you, whether the harm was intentional or negligent.
services.lead: Personal injury covers more than bodily harm. It takes in pain and suffering and emotional distress as well, and the three legal types are negligence, strict liability and intentional wrongs.

covers.title: Negligence
covers.text: The most common type. An injury caused by someone's careless behaviour, where another person in the same situation would not have made that mistake.

covers.title: Strict liability
covers.text: An injury caused by an action or a product regardless of intent. A faulty product is the clearest example: the manufacturer is responsible even with no intention of harm.

covers.title: Intentional wrongs
covers.text: Bodily injury caused on purpose, such as assault, battery and intentional emotional distress.

covers.title: Defective products
covers.text: Faulty vehicle parts, consumer products, medical devices and pharmaceuticals fall under product liability law.

covers.title: Slips, falls and medical malpractice
covers.text: Accidents run from car and motorcycle crashes to slips and falls and medical malpractice suits, and most of them fall under negligence.

covers.title: Defamation
covers.text: Harming someone's reputation with words rather than with weapons falls under personal injury law as well.

questions.q: How long do I have to bring a claim in Texas?
questions.a: The statute of limitations for personal injuries in Texas is two years. It is five years for sex crimes and one year for libel or slander.

questions.q: What if I was partly at fault?
questions.a: Some accidents are found to be the fault of both parties, and you would not be entitled to collect personal injury compensation if you were more than 50% at fault.

It is the duty to do something safely so that nobody gets hurt: a driver driving safely, a medical professional providing care, a manufacturer making a product that does no harm, a grocery store keeping its floors dry.

services.title: Dog Bite Injuries
services.text: Dog bites cause serious injuries, including puncture wounds, infection and scarring. We review your case and help you get the compensation you deserve.
services.lead: If you or someone you love has been injured by a dog bite, you may qualify for compensation. Our attorneys review what happened and take it from there.

services.title: Wrongful Death
services.summary: For families who lost someone in an accident.
services.text: If you have lost someone in an accident you may be entitled to compensation, including funeral expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering.
services.lead: We recognise that this is a difficult time, and we will do everything in our power to get you the compensation you deserve. You cannot trust just anyone with a wrongful death case.

services.title: Boating Accidents
services.summary: Injuries on the water and what they cost.
services.text: Like car or motorcycle accidents, boating accidents can leave you with serious expenses for medical care, loss, and pain and suffering.
services.lead: If you were hurt in a boating accident, our attorneys review your case and help you get the compensation you deserve.

services.title: Uninsured Motorist Claims
services.summary: When the other driver has no coverage.
services.text: An accident with an uninsured driver does not have to mean going without the compensation you deserve.
services.lead: Our legal team reviews your situation and helps you get the coverage and the care that you need after a crash with a driver who was not insured.

process.title: What a personal injury case looks like
process.text: If you have been injured by someone or something, these are the steps the process takes.

steps.title: Harm is done
steps.text: Harm is done to someone by someone else.

steps.title: An attorney is retained
steps.text: You contact an injury lawyer with the details of your claim, and they carry out their own investigation to determine whether you have a case.

steps.title: Legal action is taken
steps.text: Once there is a case, the paperwork is filed against the other party and the settlement process begins.

steps.title: Settlement
steps.text: Against an insurance company, the matter is usually decided outside of court in a settlement agreement. If no settlement is reached, it moves to litigation.

steps.title: Litigation
steps.text: A judge determines whether the person who did the harm is liable and how much the compensation will be. Talks can continue, and a settlement may still be reached outside the courtroom.

about.title: A firm built on trust, success and experience
text: The lawyers at Salazar & Velazquez, P.C. focus on getting real results for their clients and families. Our firm represents families and individuals who have suffered minor and major injuries or death due to the negligence of others.

The insurance companies want to avoid paying what is rightfully yours by any means. You have the right to compensation for medical expenses, lost income, the cost of long-term medical attention, rehabilitation or therapy, and for the pain, suffering and the loss of being able to enjoy life after an accident.

We are detail-oriented when we prepare a case and strict when it comes to searching for the maximum compensation you deserve for damages and losses. We handle personal injury cases under a contingency contract and take care of the costs up front, so you pay nothing until your case has been resolved.

team.name: Elisa Salazar
team.bio: Elisa Contreras Salazar graduated from Angelo State University in 2002 with a degree in Arts in Spanish and English, and took her law degree at the Thurgood Marshall School of Law in Houston, where she served as general director of the Thurgood Marshall Law Review and interned for Judge George C. Hanks of the First Court of Appeals. She began her career at Fridge & Resendez, LLC as an associate attorney in commercial litigation and personal injuries, and joined a Houston personal injury practice in February 2007. She spent six years at that firm, helping run the office and managing hundreds of cases to a successful resolution, with a focus on car and truck accidents, falls, work accidents and wrongful death. In August 2013 she was chosen by Mayor Annise Parker to serve as an associate judge for the municipal courts of the city of Houston, and she served until August 2017. In May 2014 she earned her master's in Law and International Law from the University of Houston Law Center.
team.imageAlt: Elisa Salazar, attorney at Salazar & Velazquez

team.name: Paola Muraira Velazquez
team.bio: Paola was raised in Texas and completed her degree in Political Science at Texas A&M University in Corpus Christi in 2003, then took her law degree at the Thurgood Marshall School of Law in Houston, where she was a member of the Student Bar Association, the Hispanic Law Student Association and the Phi Alpha Delta law fraternity, and interned at the Court of Appeals in Corpus Christi. After graduating she returned to Corpus Christi and joined a firm that handled a wide variety of cases. In 2008 she moved to Houston to join a firm focused on personal injuries, where she spent five years working on hundreds of transit accident, truck accident, wrongful death and work accident cases, and where her native Spanish made her central to the firm's Spanish-speaking clients. In March 2014 she was appointed by Mayor Annise Parker to serve Houston as a hearing adjudication officer. Paola met Elisa in law school, and the two founded Salazar & Velazquez, P.C. in 2013.

faqs.q: What does it cost to hire you?
faqs.a: We handle personal injury cases under a contingency contract, which means you only pay if the case is resolved successfully. We take care of all the costs up front, so you do not pay anything until then.
Yes. We offer complimentary consultations so we can learn about your case and help you understand your legal options.

faqs.q: What if I cannot travel to the office?
faqs.a: If you cannot travel because of your injuries, we can come to you.

faqs.q: How long do I have to file a personal injury claim in Texas?
faqs.a: Two years for personal injuries, five years for sex crimes and one year for libel or slander.

faqs.q: Will my case end up in court?
faqs.a: Not usually. 95% of all injury claims are settled out of court, though we prepare every case as though it will be heard.
